name: Biocytogen Pharmaceuticals (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
summary: Biocytogen Pharmaceuticals (Beijing) Co., Ltd., a biotechnology company, engages in the research and development of novel antibody-based drugs and pre-clinical research services in the People's Republic of China, the United States, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Gene-Editing; Pharmacological Efficacy; Model Animals; Antibody Development; and Other.
